meta.title: SYNTARO Competitive Benchmark
meta.description: Head-to-head comparison of issue-to-PR automation tools across quality gates, cost, pass rates, and deployment options.
meta.source: XOR benchmark, Gartner, internal evaluations, competitor public data

competitors.name: SYNTARO
competitors.notes: 6 deterministic quality gates including hallucination detection, dead code check, and anti-injection. OpenCode native, sandboxed via E2B. Real-time status streaming to issue comments.

competitors.name: Plip.io
competitors.notes: SaaS-only. Free tier limited to 10 fixes/month. No self-host option. No quality gates or prompt injection protection reported.

competitors.name: TaskBounty
competitors.notes: Marketplace + subscription model. Wide cost range depends on bounty difficulty. No built-in quality gates. SaaS-only.

competitors.name: KintsugiBot
competitors.notes: Newest OSS entrant. Supports any LLM but user pays API costs directly. No quality gate framework or anti-hallucination measures built in.

competitors.name: Open SWE
competitors.notes: LangChain-based. 10K+ GitHub stars. Mature OSS project but no deterministic quality gates. Pass rate lags behind dedicated AGI solutions.

metrics.label: Benchmark Pass Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of issues correctly fixed and verified on the XOR / DeepSWE benchmark. Higher is better.

metrics.label: Cost Per Fix
metrics.description: Average cost in USD to resolve a single issue, including model inference and infrastructure. Lower is better.

metrics.label: Quality Gates
metrics.description: Deterministic pre-PR checks (compile, test integrity, hallucination detection, dead code, anti-injection). Prevents bad fixes from reaching review.

metrics.label: Prompt Injection Protection
metrics.description: Guards against prompt injection attacks via issue body or code comments. Critical for production deployments on public repos.

methodology.benchmark: XOR / DeepSWE benchmark suite — 500+ real-world GitHub issues across Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Go repositories. Each fix is scored on correctness, test pass rate, and code quality.
methodology.costModel: SYNTARO cost assumes hosted tier at projected pricing ($3–4/fix). Competitor costs from published pricing pages and community reports. BYO API costs exclude developer time and infrastructure overhead.
methodology.qualityGates: SYNTARO runs 6 deterministic gates before any PR is created. Other tools are assessed based on published documentation and codebase analysis.
